translation.sourceText: Hebrew Masoretic text (Westminster Leningrad Codex base, Public Domain) — Tanach with Ta'amei Hamikra

verdicts.reasoning: wîrîḥô sōḡereṯ ûməsuggereṯ: Qal + Pual participles of sgr, 'shut up and closed tight'; ʾên yôṣēʾ wəʾên bāʾ. Exact.
rəʾēh nāṯattî ḇəyāḏəḵā: the perfect of assurance 'I have given'; gibbôrê heḥāyil in apposition to 'its king' as in the MT. Exact.
wəsabbōṯem ... haqqêp̄ ʾeṯ-hāʿîr paʿam ʾeḥāṯ: infinitive absolute 'circling the city once'; the shift to the singular tāʿăśeh is levelled to 'you', acceptable English.

šiḇʿâ šôp̄rôṯ hayyôḇəlîm: 'seven shofars of rams' horns'. yôḇēl = ram (BDB yôḇēl 1); šôp̄ār is the animal horn, distinct from ḥăṣōṣərâ. The transliteration is lexically motivated, not lens-motivated, and is the proposed central convention.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Re-parsed: bimšōḵ bəqeren hayyôḇēl; Ketiv bšmʿkm / Qere kəšomʿăḵem (preposition only), Qere translated. tərûʿâ gəḏôlâ is the people's shout; wənāp̄əlâ ḥômaṯ hāʿîr taḥteyhā 'fall down flat' (ASV). The reception note accurately reports TBWTT ch. 3 (ultrasound, 'trumpet' of the French and English Bibles), and the line uses no technical vocabulary.
śəʾû ʾeṯ-ʾărôn habbərîṯ ... lip̄nê ʾărôn YHWH: both genitives are kept as written. Exact.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv wyʾmrw 'and they said' / Qere wayyōʾmer 'and he said': the line translates the Qere, and the note records that the ASV follows the Ketiv. heḥālûṣ 'the armed men' (collective). Exact.
lip̄nê YHWH where vv 4, 6 have 'before the ark' is preserved, with a sober note (Num 10:35-36). Exact.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv tqʿw (perfect) / Qere tōqəʿê (construct participle), Qere translated. hālôḵ wəṯāqôaʿ with no expressed subject is left unexpressed, against the ASV's supplied '[the priests]', per the MT-baseline entry. Exact.
lōʾ ṯārîʿû wəlōʾ-ṯašmîʿû ʾeṯ-qôləḵem ... hārîʿû wahărîʿōṯem: exact.
wayyassēḇ ʾărôn-YHWH (Hiphil) 'he caused the ark ... to go around' renders the causative correctly; wayyālînû 'lodged'. Exact.
wayyaškēm yəhôšuaʿ babbōqer wayyiśʾû hakkōhănîm ʾeṯ-ʾărôn YHWH: exact.

citations: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (3rd ed., 2012), on Ketiv/Qere
verdicts.reasoning: Ketiv hwlk (participle) / Qere hālôḵ (infinitive absolute), same sense, Qere translated; hōləḵîm hālôḵ wəṯāqəʿû 'were going on continually and blowing'. Subject of the final clause unexpressed as in v 9. Exact.
wayyāsōbbû ... bayyôm haššēnî paʿam ʾaḥaṯ ... kōh ʿāśû šēšeṯ yāmîm: exact.
kaʿălôṯ haššaḥar 'at the coming up of the dawn'; kammišpāṭ hazzeh 'in this manner'. Exact.
bappaʿam haššəḇîʿîṯ tāqəʿû hakkōhănîm ... hārîʿû kî-nāṯan YHWH lāḵem ʾeṯ-hāʿîr: exact.

wəhāyəṯâ hāʿîr ḥērem hîʾ ... laYHWH: 'shall be devoted ... to YHWH' renders the noun without the ASV's interpretive variation. Mesha stele line 17 (hḥrmth) is correctly cited. hammalʾāḵîm are the human spies, rendered 'messengers'.

citations: Boling and Wright, Joshua (AB 6; 1982), ad loc.
verdicts.reasoning: Re-parsed: pen-taḥărîmû ûləqaḥtem min-haḥērem wəśamtem ʾeṯ-maḥănēh yiśrāʾēl ləḥērem. MT kept against LXX 'covet' (= taḥmədû), which is accurately reported; the changed 'make the camp ... a devoted thing' replaces the ASV 'accursed' and keeps the threefold play on the root visible. Defensible and more literal.
wəḵōl kesep̄ wəzāhāḇ ûḵəlê nəḥōšeṯ ûḇarzel qōḏeš hûʾ laYHWH ʾôṣar YHWH yāḇôʾ: exact; nəḥōšeṯ 'bronze' is standard.
MT sequence (shout, blast, hearing, great shout, collapse) kept with the unexpressed subject of wayyiṯqəʿû; LXX smoothing recorded. wattippōl haḥômâ taḥteyhā 'fell down flat'. Exact.

wayyaḥărîmû 'they devoted to destruction' (changed from ASV 'utterly destroyed'): the Hiphil denotes the sacral transfer carried out by destruction, and the rendering is the standard modern one (NRSV). It neither softens nor sharpens the text.
wəlišnayim hāʾănāšîm hamraggəlîm ʾeṯ-hāʾāreṣ ... bêṯ-hāʾiššâ hazzônâ: 'the prostitute's house' renders the construct with attributive zônâ idiomatically. Exact.
hannəʿārîm hamraggəlîm 'the young men, the spies'; wəʾēṯ kol-mišpəḥôṯeyhā 'all her kindred'; wayyannîḥûm miḥûṣ ləmaḥănēh yiśrāʾēl. Exact.
wəhāʿîr śārəp̄û ḇāʾēš ... nāṯənû ʾôṣar bêṯ-YHWH: exact; the anachronistic 'house of YHWH' is kept as written.
heḥĕyâ yəhôšuaʿ 'Yehoshua saved alive'; wattēšeḇ bəqereḇ yiśrāʾēl ʿaḏ hayyôm hazzeh. Exact.
wayyašbaʿ (Hiphil) 'made them swear'; bibḵōrô ... ûḇiṣʿîrô: bə- of price, 'with the loss of' (ASV). The LXX plus on Hiel (cf. 1 Kgs 16:34) is correctly reported and not translated.
wayhî YHWH ʾeṯ-yəhôšuaʿ wayhî šomʿô bəḵol-hāʾāreṣ: exact.

founderDecisionRecommendations.1-1Sam-6:18-great-stone: Ship. ʾāḇēl cannot be construed (two failed agreements, contradiction with vv 14-15); ʾeḇen with LXX, Targum and some Hebrew MSS is the standard correction (Driver 1913; McCarter 1980). Ratify the exception exactly as narrowly worded (MT grammatically impossible + Hebrew-manuscript reading supported by the versions).
founderDecisionRecommendations.2-gentilics: Keep the Kings '-ite' rule in the Former Prophets now (option c); it maps one-to-one to the ASV and is already ratified for Kings. For the later corpus pass, the reviewer prefers (a) '-ite' throughout, with the central pelishtim-caphtor plural becoming 'the Pelishtites', because 'the Pelishtite' beside 'the Pelishtim' is the one jarring pair. No philological issue either way; it is a presentation choice.
founderDecisionRecommendations.3-Judg-6:40-the-Elohim: Confirm. The ratified Kings text explicitly leaves the central narrative-subject rule ('the Elohim') in force and limits the article-less form to predicates, genitives and direct-speech subjects; the brief's paraphrase was inaccurate. Clause 6 applies the ratified text exactly.
founderDecisionRecommendations.4-Judg-6:34-clothed: Ship. lāḇəšâ is literally 'clothed' (BDB; same idiom 1 Chr 12:19; 2 Chr 24:20; Block), and keeping Judges' four verbs distinct is a gain in accuracy.
founderDecisionRecommendations.5-herem: Ship. 'devote(d) to destruction' is the standard modern rendering (NRSV; HALOT) and the only consistent one; it makes the Josh 6 / Josh 10 connection visible without moral editorializing.
founderDecisionRecommendations.6-shofar-promotion: Approve the promotion after the refId fix (EXO-WOH-20:15 for 20:18; optionally add EXO-WOH-19:13). Retire the 1-kings-woh shofar entry to a pointer and let the exodus-woh overlays cite the central id.

paragraphs.text: וִֽירִיחוֹ֙ סֹגֶ֣רֶת וּמְסֻגֶּ֔רֶת מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ין יוֹצֵ֖א וְאֵ֥ין בָּֽא׃ (ס)

i18n.en: Now Yericho was shut up and closed tight because of the children of Yisra'el: none went out, and none came in.

notes.official: *wîrîḥô sōḡereṯ ûməsuggereṯ* 'Now Yericho was shut up and closed tight' (ASV 'straitly shut up'): the Qal and Pual participles of *sgr* stress that the city was sealed. Yericho = Jericho; Yisra'el = Israel.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָֽדְךָ֔ אֶת־יְרִיח֖וֹ וְאֶת־מַלְכָּ֑הּ גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י הֶחָֽיִל׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Yehoshua, "See, I have given into your hand Yericho and its king, the mighty men of valor.

notes.official: *rəʾēh nāṯattî ḇəyāḏəḵā* 'See, I have given into your hand': the perfect presents the outcome as already settled (`be-yedkhem-nittanu`). *gibbôrê heḥāyil* 'the mighty men of valor' stands in apposition to 'its king'. Yehoshua = Joshua.

paragraphs.text: וְסַבֹּתֶ֣ם אֶת־הָעִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַקֵּ֥יף אֶת־הָעִ֖יר פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

i18n.en: And you shall go around the city, all the men of war, circling the city once. Thus you shall do six days.

paragraphs.text: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹהֲנִ֡ים יִשְׂאוּ֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י תָּסֹ֥בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And seven priests shall carry seven shofars of rams' horns before the ark; and on the seventh day you shall go around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the shofars.

notes.official: *šiḇʿâ šôp̄rôṯ hayyôḇəlîm* 'seven shofars of rams' horns' (ASV 'seven trumpets of rams' horns'): *šôp̄ār* is rendered 'shofar' under the proposed central `shofar-rams-horn-signal-instrument-cross-corpus`, as at Sinai and at Shelomoh's accession (1 Kgs 1:34-41). The instrument is the animal horn, distinct from the metal *ḥăṣōṣərâ* 'trumpet' of Num 10:2-10. *yôḇēl* is the ram (cf. Ex 19:13); its later sense 'jubilee' derives from the horn that proclaimed it. The number seven structures the rite: seven priests, seven horns, seven days, seven circuits on the seventh day. *wəhakkōhănîm yiṯqəʿû* 'and the priests shall blow' (`teruah-great-shout-wall-falls-flat-joshua-6`). 'the ark' per central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ ׀ בְּקֶ֣רֶן הַיּוֹבֵ֗ל בשמעכם [כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶם֙] אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר יָרִ֥יעוּ כָל־הָעָ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָעִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ וְעָל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And it shall be, when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, when you hear the sound of the shofar, that all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight before him."

notes.official:
*bimšōḵ bəqeren hayyôḇēl* 'when they make a long blast with the ram's horn': *māšaḵ* 'draw out', a sustained note (cf. Ex 19:13). *kəšomʿăḵem* 'when you hear' translates the Qere; the Ketiv *bšmʿkm* differs only in the preposition (*bə-* for *kə-*), with no change of sense (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). *yārîʿû ḵol-hāʿām tərûʿâ ḡəḏôlâ* 'all the people shall shout with a great shout': *tərûʿâ* is both a war cry and a horn signal (Num 10:5-9), and here it is the people's shout, their 'voice' (v 10) (`teruah-great-shout-wall-falls-flat-joshua-6`). *wənāp̄əlâ ḥômaṯ hāʿîr taḥteyhā* 'and the wall of the city shall fall down flat': literally 'shall fall beneath itself', that is, collapse where it stands (ASV 'fall down flat'). *ʾîš negdô* 'every man straight before him'.

**Wheel of Heaven reading (reception note, not a translation claim).** The Book Which Tells the Truth (ch. 3) quotes this verse with 'the trumpet' of the French and English Bibles and reads the instrument as a complex device emitting amplified ultrasound, which brought down the wall at a synchronized moment. The line renders *šôp̄ār* and *qeren hayyôḇēl* as the ram's-horn instrument the Hebrew names and uses no technical vocabulary.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּקְרָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־נוּן֙ אֶל־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם שְׂא֖וּ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הַבְּרִ֑ית וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹֽהֲנִ֗ים יִשְׂאוּ֙ שִׁבְעָ֤ה שֽׁוֹפְרוֹת֙ יוֹבְלִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests carry seven shofars of rams' horns before the ark of YHWH."

notes.official: Yehoshua bin Nun = Joshua the son of Nun. *ʾărôn habbərîṯ* 'the ark of the covenant' and *ʾărôn YHWH* 'the ark of YHWH' alternate in the chapter as in the Hebrew (central `aron-ark-of-the-covenant-ark-of-the-elohim-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: ויאמרו [וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙] אֶל־הָעָ֔ם עִבְר֖וּ וְסֹ֣בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֑יר וְהֶ֣חָל֔וּץ יַעֲבֹ֕ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And he said to the people, "Pass on, and go around the city, and let the armed men pass on before the ark of YHWH."

notes.official: *wayyōʾmer* 'And he said' translates the Qere, with Yehoshua as speaker. The Ketiv *wyʾmrw* 'and they said', which the ASV follows ('And they said'), would make the priests the speakers (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). *heḥālûṣ* 'the armed men' (ASV): the vanguard of picked troops (cf. 4:13).

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֗י כֶּאֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל־הָעָם֒ וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַיּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַֽאֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass, when Yehoshua had spoken to the people, that the seven priests carrying the seven shofars of rams' horns before YHWH passed on and blew the shofars; and the ark of the covenant of YHWH was going after them.

notes.official: *lip̄nê YHWH* 'before YHWH': the narrator writes 'before YHWH' where vv 4 and 6 have 'before the ark', so the ark stands for YHWH's presence (cf. Num 10:35-36). *ʾărôn bərîṯ YHWH* 'the ark of the covenant of YHWH'.

paragraphs.text: וְהֶחָל֣וּץ הֹלֵ֔ךְ לִפְנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים תקעו [תֹּקְעֵ֖י] הַשּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאָר֔וֹן הָל֖וֹךְ וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And the armed men were going before the priests who blew the shofars, and the rear guard was going after the ark, going on and blowing the shofars.

notes.official: *tōqəʿê haššôp̄ārôṯ* 'the priests who blew the shofars' translates the Qere, a participle in construct ('the blowers of'); the Ketiv *tqʿw* 'they blew' is a perfect from the same consonants (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). *wəhamməʾassēp̄* 'the rear guard'. The subject of the closing *hālôḵ wəṯāqôaʿ baššôp̄ārôṯ* 'going on and blowing the shofars' is not expressed. The ASV supplies '[the priests]'; the line leaves it unexpressed (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וְאֶת־הָעָם֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֤א תָרִ֙יעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־תַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶת־קוֹלְכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יֵצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֣וֹם אָמְרִ֧י אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הָרִ֖יעוּ וַהֲרִיעֹתֶֽם׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua commanded the people, saying, "You shall not shout, nor let your voice be heard, nor shall a word go out of your mouth, until the day I say to you, 'Shout!' Then you shall shout."

notes.official: *lōʾ ṯārîʿû* 'You shall not shout': six days of silence prepare the single great shout of v 20 (`teruah-great-shout-wall-falls-flat-joshua-6`).

paragraphs.text: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב אֲרוֹן־יְהוָה֙ אֶת־הָעִ֔יר הַקֵּ֖ף פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃ (פ)

i18n.en: So he caused the ark of YHWH to go around the city, circling it once; and they came into the camp and lodged in the camp.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of YHWH.

paragraphs.text: וְשִׁבְעָ֣ה הַכֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֜וֹת הַיֹּבְלִ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הֹלְכִ֣ים הָל֔וֹךְ וְתָקְע֖וּ בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְהֶחָלוּץ֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְהַֽמְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הולך [הָל֖וֹךְ] וְתָק֥וֹעַ בַּשּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת׃

i18n.en: And the seven priests carrying the seven shofars of rams' horns before the ark of YHWH were going on continually and blowing the shofars; and the armed men were going before them, and the rear guard was going after the ark of YHWH, going on and blowing the shofars.

notes.official: *hālôḵ* 'going on' translates the Qere (infinitive absolute); the Ketiv *hwlk* is the participle, with the same sense (`ketiv-qere-qere-translated-former-prophets`). As in v 9, the subject of the final 'blowing the shofars' is unexpressed (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּסֹ֨בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֜יר בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃

i18n.en: And on the second day they went around the city once and returned to the camp. Thus they did six days.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֣י ׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַיַּשְׁכִּ֙מוּ֙ כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔חַר וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ אֶת־הָעִ֛יר כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים רַ֚ק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא סָבְב֥וּ אֶת־הָעִ֖יר שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day that they rose early at the coming up of the dawn and went around the city in this manner seven times; only on that day they went around the city seven times.

notes.official: *kaʿălôṯ haššaḥar* 'at the coming up of the dawn'; *kammišpāṭ hazzeh* 'in this manner' (ASV 'after the same manner').

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִי֙ בַּפַּ֣עַם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ית תָּקְע֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּשּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל־הָעָם֙ הָרִ֔יעוּ כִּֽי־נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָעִֽיר׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew the shofars, that Yehoshua said to the people, "Shout! For YHWH has given you the city.

notes.official: *hārîʿû kî-nāṯan YHWH lāḵem ʾeṯ-hāʿîr* 'Shout! For YHWH has given you the city' (`teruah-great-shout-wall-falls-flat-joshua-6`; `shofar-rams-horn-signal-instrument-cross-corpus`).

paragraphs.text: וְהָיְתָ֨ה הָעִ֥יר חֵ֛רֶם הִ֥יא וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֖הּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה רַק֩ רָחָ֨ב הַזּוֹנָ֜ה תִּֽחְיֶ֗ה הִ֚יא וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֣הּ בַּבַּ֔יִת כִּ֣י הֶחְבְּאַ֔תָה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלָֽחְנוּ׃

i18n.en: And the city shall be devoted, it and all that is in it, to YHWH; only Rachav the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.

notes.official: *wəhāyəṯâ hāʿîr ḥērem* 'And the city shall be devoted': *ḥērem* is what is set apart for YHWH by being withdrawn from human use, in war normally by destruction (Lev 27:28-29; Deut 7:2; 20:16-18). The Moabite stone uses the same verb of Mesha's war against Israel (line 17, 'I devoted it') (Stern, *The Biblical Ḥerem*, BJS 211, 1991; Lohfink, TDOT V). The noun is rendered 'devoted' / 'the devoted thing' and the Hiphil verb 'devote to destruction' throughout Josh 6 and 10 (`herem-devoted-devote-to-destruction-joshua`). Rachav = Rahab; *hazzônâ* 'the prostitute' (`zonah-prostitute-status-vocabulary-cross-corpus`). *hammalʾāḵîm* 'the messengers' are the two spies of ch. 2, human envoys (`malakh-yhwh-messenger`).

paragraphs.text: וְרַק־אַתֶּם֙ שִׁמְר֣וּ מִן־הַחֵ֔רֶם פֶּֽן־תַּחֲרִ֖ימוּ וּלְקַחְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַחֵ֑רֶם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־מַחֲנֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֵ֔רֶם וַעֲכַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: But as for you, keep yourselves from the devoted thing, lest when you have devoted it you take of the devoted thing, and so make the camp of Yisra'el a devoted thing, and trouble it.

notes.official: *šimrû min-haḥērem pen-taḥărîmû ûləqaḥtem min-haḥērem* 'keep yourselves from the devoted thing, lest when you have devoted it you take of the devoted thing' (MT). The LXX reads 'lest you covet' (= *taḥmədû*), which anticipates Akhan's 'I coveted them' (7:21), and many modern versions adopt it. The MT makes sense (having devoted the city, do not then take from it) and is kept (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). *wəśamtem ʾeṯ-maḥănēh yiśrāʾēl ləḥērem* 'and so make the camp of Yisra'el a devoted thing' (ASV 'accursed'): what is taken from the *ḥērem* passes its status to the camp, as ch. 7 narrates (`herem-devoted-devote-to-destruction-joshua`). *waʿăḵartem ʾôṯô* 'and trouble it' anticipates the valley of Akhor (7:25-26).

paragraphs.text: וְכֹ֣ל ׀ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב וּכְלֵ֤י נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וּבַרְזֶ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה אוֹצַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יָבֽוֹא׃

i18n.en: But all the silver and gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, are holy to YHWH; they shall come into the treasury of YHWH."

notes.official: *qōḏeš hûʾ laYHWH* 'are holy to YHWH': the metals go into 'the treasury of YHWH' instead of being destroyed (cf. Num 31:22-23).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּ֣רַע הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּתְקְע֖וּ בַּשֹּֽׁפָר֑וֹת וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ הָעָ֜ם אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֗ר וַיָּרִ֤יעוּ הָעָם֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַתִּפֹּ֨ל הַֽחוֹמָ֜ה תַּחְתֶּ֗יהָ וַיַּ֨עַל הָעָ֤ם הָעִ֙ירָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ נֶגְדּ֔וֹ וַֽיִּלְכְּד֖וּ אֶת־הָעִֽיר׃

i18n.en: So the people shouted, and they blew the shofars; and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the shofar, that the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, and the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

notes.official: The MT order is kept: the people shout, the shofars are blown, the people hear the shofar and shout the great shout, and the wall falls. *wayyiṯqəʿû* 'and they blew' has no expressed subject (ASV '[the priests]'), and the LXX has a smoother sequence (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`). *wattippōl haḥômâ taḥteyhā* 'and the wall fell down flat' (see v 5; `teruah-great-shout-wall-falls-flat-joshua-6`). The reception note at v 5 applies to this verse.

paragraphs.text: וַֽיַּחֲרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר מֵאִישׁ֙ וְעַד־אִשָּׁ֔ה מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד־זָקֵ֑ן וְעַ֨ד שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֛ה וַחֲמ֖וֹר לְפִי־חָֽרֶב׃

i18n.en: And they devoted to destruction all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox and sheep and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

notes.official: *wayyaḥărîmû* 'And they devoted to destruction' (ASV 'utterly destroyed'; NRSV 'devoted to destruction'): the Hiphil of *ḥrm* carries out the *ḥērem* announced in v 17. The line keeps the root visible (`herem-devoted-devote-to-destruction-joshua`).

paragraphs.text: וְלִשְׁנַ֨יִם הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הַֽמְרַגְּלִ֤ים אֶת־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בֹּ֖אוּ בֵּית־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזּוֹנָ֑ה וְהוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִשָּׁ֤ם אֶת־הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָ֔הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּ֖ם לָֽהּ׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute's house, and bring out from there the woman and all that she has, as you swore to her."

notes.official: *bêṯ-hāʾiššâ hazzônâ* 'the prostitute's house' (`zonah-prostitute-status-vocabulary-cross-corpus`); *kaʾăšer nišbaʿtem lāh* 'as you swore to her' (2:12-14).

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ הַנְּעָרִ֣ים הַֽמְרַגְּלִ֗ים וַיֹּצִ֡יאוּ אֶת־רָ֠חָב וְאֶת־אָבִ֨יהָ וְאֶת־אִמָּ֤הּ וְאֶת־אַחֶ֙יהָ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָ֔הּ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶ֖יהָ הוֹצִ֑יאוּ וַיַּ֨נִּיח֔וּם מִח֖וּץ לְמַחֲנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

i18n.en: And the young men, the spies, went in and brought out Rachav, and her father, and her mother, and her brothers, and all that she had; and all her kindred they brought out; and they set them outside the camp of Yisra'el.

notes.official: *hannəʿārîm hamraggəlîm* 'the young men, the spies'. *wayyannîḥûm miḥûṣ ləmaḥănēh yiśrāʾēl* 'and they set them outside the camp of Yisra'el': Rachav's household is spared but not yet part of the camp.

paragraphs.text: וְהָעִ֛יר שָׂרְפ֥וּ בָאֵ֖שׁ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑הּ רַ֣ק ׀ הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֗ב וּכְלֵ֤י הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וְהַבַּרְזֶ֔ל נָתְנ֖וּ אוֹצַ֥ר בֵּית־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And they burned the city with fire, and all that was in it; only the silver and the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of YHWH.

paragraphs.text: וְֽאֶת־רָחָ֣ב הַ֠זּוֹנָה וְאֶת־בֵּ֨ית אָבִ֤יהָ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָהּ֙ הֶחֱיָ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י הֶחְבִּ֙יאָה֙ אֶת־הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לְרַגֵּ֥ל אֶת־יְרִיחֽוֹ׃ (פ)

i18n.en: But Rachav the prostitute, and her father's household, and all that she had, Yehoshua saved alive; and she has dwelt in the midst of Yisra'el unto this day, because she hid the messengers whom Yehoshua sent to spy out Yericho.

notes.official: *wattēšeḇ bəqereḇ yiśrāʾēl ʿaḏ hayyôm hazzeh* 'and she has dwelt in the midst of Yisra'el unto this day' (`ad-ha-yom-ha-zeh-aetiological-formula`): the formula treats Rachav's household as still present in the narrator's time. The messengers are the spies of ch. 2 (`malakh-yhwh-messenger`).

paragraphs.text: וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖יא לֵאמֹ֑ר אָר֨וּר הָאִ֜ישׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָקוּם֙ וּבָנָ֞ה אֶת־הָעִ֤יר הַזֹּאת֙ אֶת־יְרִיח֔וֹ בִּבְכֹר֣וֹ יְיַסְּדֶ֔נָּה וּבִצְעִיר֖וֹ יַצִּ֥יב דְּלָתֶֽיהָ׃

i18n.en: And Yehoshua made them swear at that time, saying, "Cursed before YHWH be the man who rises up and builds this city, Yericho: with the loss of his firstborn he shall lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest he shall set up its gates."

notes.official: *ʾārûr* 'Cursed' (`arur-curse-formula-patriarchal-utterance-cross-corpus`). *bibḵōrô yəyassədennâ ûḇiṣʿîrô yaṣṣîḇ dəlāṯeyhā* 'with the loss of his firstborn he shall lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest he shall set up its gates': *bə-* of price (NRSV 'at the cost of'); the ASV 'with the loss of' is kept. The curse is fulfilled by Hiel of Beit-El at 1 Kgs 16:34, and the LXX adds that fulfilment here; it is not translated (`mt-baseline-at-versional-cruxes-former-prophets`).

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַיְהִ֥י שָׁמְע֖וֹ בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

i18n.en: So YHWH was with Yehoshua, and his fame was in all the land.

notes.official: *wayhî YHWH ʾeṯ-yəhôšuaʿ* 'So YHWH was with Yehoshua' (`elohim-imkha-divine-presence-formula`), fulfilling the promise of 1:5.
